The narrow safe variant of the vague-intensifier rule. The bare word list is NOT shipped — it flags ordinary English.
ANTISLOP 'overclaimed completion': a completion claim with no evidence sentence beside it.
Narrow forms only. The general 'not X, but Y' family is left to judgment — broad forms flag correct contrastive writing.

Matches the adjective IN USE (before a noun / after an article), not merely enumerated, so a doc that lists the banned words is not flagged. 'powerful' is deliberately excluded — too common in correct technical prose.
Headings only, not emoji anywhere in the body.

ANTISLOP treats this list as a DENSITY signal: one is nothing, three in a page is a tell — hence minMatches 3. The lookahead requires the word to be used in a sentence, so a doc that merely lists the vocabulary does not trip it.
